title: 第187章 弥勒 老君说的没错我佛门天下无敌第186章 天道 鸿钧你大胆
slug: 从车迟国开始布局西游
lines: 在天道撕裂空间的瞬间，鸿钧便直接祭出了造化玉碟。
造化玉碟被祭出的瞬间便凝聚出无数道法则锁链，那锁链铺天盖地的朝着天道席卷而去想要将天道拦下。
天道冷笑一声:“鸿钧，想留下我你还做不到!”
说着天道便祭出一件梭状法宝。
鸿钧神色骤变：“时间之梭？！你怎么会有时间魔神的本命法宝？！”
天道也不回答鸿钧的问题，只疯狂的催动着时间之梭，一个呼吸的时间原本疯狂涌向天道的法则链条便如潮水般退去。
天道看向鸿钧：“鸿钧，你给本天道等着，等西游量劫过后便是你的死期！”
话音落下天道便跨入了刚刚撕开的空间裂缝之中，头也不回的就离开了。
鸿钧见状也没有再去追，毕竟手握时间之梭的天道单凭他确实没法直接拿下。
另一边，火焰山外二十里处
太上老君站在这里看向不远处的火焰山，他并没有立刻去找凤族的麻烦，而是静静等着佛门的人。
在他看来他就是一个帮忙的，人家正主都没来他着急什么？
差不多等了半炷香的时间，弥勒和药师才带着十多个准圣姗姗来迟。
太上老君看见弥勒和药师等人的瞬间就发现了两人有些不太对劲，可是到底哪里不对他又有些说不出来。
不过他也没有太过在意，毕竟佛门八百旁门里面邪乎的东西多了去了。
他看向弥勒直接开口道:“弥勒，如今凤族驻守火焰山，依你之见该如何渡过这一关?”
弥勒淡淡开口道:“老君，区区凤族何足挂齿?以我佛门的底蕴翻手可灭!”
太上老君的嘴角扯了扯。
你佛门抬手可灭?
你佛门现在什么个情况你自己不清楚?
你佛门要是能搞定天道还会让我帮忙？
这种话骗骗别人也就罢了，别到最后连自己都骗。
太上老君眼珠子转了转，正好他原本就不想出力，既然弥勒这么说他正好顺水推舟让佛门去打生打死。
于是他笑呵呵的开口:“说的没错，凤族早已没落，哪里会是佛门的对手?只要尔等略微出手，凤族还不得束手就擒?”
在暗处控制弥勒等人的截教弟子听到太上老君这么说，也是忍不住扯了扯嘴角。
其中一名弟子看向乌云仙:“乌云师兄，天庭竟然将太上老君给派出来了，咱们要不要改变一下计划?”
吴云仙低头想了想，然后摇了摇头:“改什么计划?即便来的是太上老君咱们也照坑不误!”
“莫说只是太上老君，今日便是昊天亲临，咱们也坑定了！”
那弟子再次开口:“乌云仙师兄，倒不是师弟没有胆子坑他，师弟是担心凤族拿不下他。”
乌云仙略一沉吟，觉得这弟子说的也没什么问题。
太上老君的实力毕竟在那摆着，凤族还真不见得是太上老君的对手。
不过太上老君都来了，不将他坑死在这火焰山乌云仙总觉得自己的念头不通达。

The moment the Heavenly Dao tore apart the space, Hongjun directly sacrificed the Jade Disc of Creation.
The moment the jade dish of creation was sacrificed, countless chains of laws were condensed, and the chains swept toward the way of heaven overwhelmingly, trying to stop the way of heaven.
Tiandao sneered: "Hongjun, if you want to keep me, you can't do it!"
After saying this, Tiandao sacrificed a spindle-shaped magic weapon.
Hongjun's expression suddenly changed: "Time Shuttle?! How come you have the magic weapon of the Time Demon?!"
Tiandao did not answer Hongjun's question, but only drove the shuttle of time crazily. In one breath, the chain of laws that had been rushing towards Tiandao receded like the tide.
Tiandao looked at Hongjun: "Hongjun, you wait for Tiandao, your death will be after the calamity of the journey to the west!"
As soon as the voice fell, Tiandao stepped into the space crack that had just been torn apart, and left without looking back.
When Hongjun saw this, he didn't pursue it anymore. After all, Tiandao, who held the shuttle of time, couldn't win it directly by himself.
On the other side, twenty miles outside the Flame Mountain
Taishang Laojun stood here and looked at the Flame Mountain not far away. He did not immediately go to trouble the Phoenix Clan, but quietly waited for the people from the Buddhist sect.
In his opinion, he was just a helper. Why was he worried when the real owner didn't come?
After waiting for almost half a stick of incense, Maitreya and the pharmacist arrived late with more than a dozen quasi-sages.
The moment Taishang Laojun saw Maitreya, Yaoshi and others, he realized that something was not right between them, but he couldn't tell what was wrong.
But he didn't pay too much attention to it. After all, there were many evil things in the eight hundred branches of Buddhism.
He looked at Maitreya and said directly: "Maitreya, now the Phoenix Clan is stationed at the Flame Mountain. In your opinion, how should we get through this situation?"
Maitreya said calmly: "Old Lord, why do you care about the Phoenix Clan? With my Buddhist background, I can destroy them with just a few hands!"
The corners of Taishang Laojun's mouth twitched.
Can you raise your hand to destroy Buddhism?
You don’t know what the current situation in Buddhism is?
If you Buddhists could figure out the way of heaven, would you still let me help?
It’s okay to deceive others with such words, don’t even deceive yourself in the end.
Taishang Laojun rolled his eyes. It just so happened that he didn't want to make any effort in the first place. Since Maitreya said so, he just let the Buddha go and fight for life and death.
So he said with a smile: "You are right, the Phoenix Clan has long been in decline, how can it be the opponent of Buddhism? As long as you and others make a little move, the Feng Clan will still be able to catch them without mercy?"
The Jie Jiao disciples who were controlling Maitreya and others in the dark couldn't help but twitch their lips when they heard Taishang Laojun say this.
One of the disciples looked at Wu Yunxian: "Senior Brother Wu Yun, Heaven has actually sent Taishang Laojun. Should we change our plan?"
Wu Yunxian lowered his head and thought for a while, then shook his head: "What kind of change of plan? Even if it is Taishang Laojun, we will still stick to the trap!"
"Don't say it's just Taishang Laojun, Haotian is here today, and we are sure to be fooled!"
The disciple spoke again: "Senior Brother Wu Yunxian, it's not that I don't have the guts to trick him, it's because I'm worried that the Feng Clan won't be able to take him down."
Wu Yunxian pondered for a moment and felt that there was nothing wrong with what this disciple said.
After all, Taishang Laojun's strength is there, and the Feng Clan is really not necessarily Taishang Laojun's opponent.
But Taishang Laojun is here, and Wuyunxian will always feel that his thoughts are not clear unless he is trapped to death in this Flame Mountain.
title_en: Chapter 187 Maitreya, Laojun is right, I am invincible in the world of Buddhism Chapter 186 Heavenly Dao, Hongjun, you are brave
